description: Convert between Unix timestamps (seconds or milliseconds) and ISO-8601 / UTC date strings. Auto-detects epoch vs. millisecond format. Omit input to get the current time. Returns iso, unix_s, unix_ms, utc, date, and time fields.

input.description: Unix timestamp (number, seconds or ms) or ISO date string. Omit to get the current time.

name: timestamp_convert
